## Coherence checks

- [ ] V1 provides a complete useful experience rather than disconnected feature fragments.
- [ ] Every starting tier is coherent and usable.
- [ ] No tier promises a capability missing from its target release.
- [ ] Add-on treatment does not bypass required dependencies.
- [ ] Planned/unavailable UI behavior is defined.
- [ ] Rollout controls do not redefine commercial eligibility.
- [ ] Release changes identify affected workflows, tests, documentation and entitlements.
- [ ] Tentative ideas are clearly separated from commitments.

## Owner decision

**Approved / Needs Adjustment / Rejected**
